title: Review of c03's metabolic no-turnover finding (negative): replicates on fresh seed 5 (F=0.01: 24 -> 70 bodies then 0 splits and 0 deaths for t=1200-2400; F=0.004: 26 static bodies)
summary: Ran the parent fch-metabolic world (F=0.01) and world_F0.004.py unchanged on seed 5 to t=2400 and counted with the finding's turnover.py (6 windows). F=0.01: 41 splits in the first half (16, 15, 10), then 0 splits, 0 deaths and 1 nucleation over the second half at 69-70 bodies. F=0.004: 24 nucleations and 2 splits in the first window, then 26 bodies unchanged with no event for the rest of the run. Same picture as the finding's seed 0: growth to a carrying capacity, then a frozen population with no intrinsic turnover.

observations.D: turnover_s5.txt: F=0.01 splits 16/15/10/0/0/0 and deaths 0/2/0/0/0/0 by sixth of the run; F=0.004 26 bodies, 0 events after the first sixth

controls_run.D: rerun/F0.01/seed5 vs rerun/F0.004/seed5 (supply sweep, same seed)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, two of the three supplies. turnover.py links bodies between frames 16 t apart; quick deaths and births inside an interval would be missed, though the stable counts make that unlikely.
